identification: Australian colonial farmhouse kitchen table, c1880-1910: pine plank top (scrubbed/natural finish, rounded corners, moulded edge) on a darker stained pine base with plain deep apron (no drawer visible on the front or end shown) and four ring-turned tapering legs on small peg feet. 152 x 87 x 76 cm. Top has two large white bleach/heat marks near one edge, dark water stains and general wear; base finish worn. Estimate 150-200, current bid A$130.

viewing_check: Look under the top for the timber (Baltic/Huon/kauri pine vs a cedar or blackwood base, which would add value), cut nails or machine screws (age), whether the legs are original and joints tight (wobble), and how deep the white bleach marks go (sand-out or not); check for a hidden end drawer.
